as_told.place_text: aboard craft near November 5, South Dakota

plain: Mario Woods, a former guard at a nuclear missile base, says he was taken aboard a craft in South Dakota and saw beings there. He says they looked like "the small Grays," the gray-skinned, big-eyed beings of many abduction stories, with a taller gray one standing behind them, like the figure on the cover of Communion, the writer Whitley Strieber's book about his own encounters. Woods tells it in two episodes, and the dates differ: one telling places it in the 1960s, the other in 1977, around November 5.
